comment: MakeHuman (MPFB) characters (docs/design/makehuman.md). tools/makehuman/mh_export.py writes each FBX under game/Saved/MakeHuman (not in Git); the MakeHumanArt commandlet imports them. Paths are relative to the repo unless absolute. localOnly models go to /Game/ThirdParty/Local and are never committed or shipped.
